mapper.select: SELECT change_request_id, user_id, change_reason, new_maturity_date, new_interest_rate, new_repayment_type, new_repayment_date, new_terms, status, created_at, updated_at, contract_id, return_reason, requester_signature FROM loan_contract_change_request WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT change_request_id, user_id, change_reason, new_maturity_date, new_interest_rate, new_repayment_type, new_repayment_date, new_terms, status, created_at, updated_at, contract_id, return_reason, requester_signature FROM loan_contract_change_request WHERE change_request_id = #{changeRequestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE loan_contract_change_request SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE change_request_id = #{changeRequestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE loan_contract_change_request SET status = #{status}, return_reason = #{returnReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE change_request_id = #{changeRequestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE loan_contract_change_request SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE change_request_id = #{changeRequestId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND requester_signature IS NULL
